problem: Material chat/agent work can be correctly recorded yet still be misread as live before the new exact head completes the full release and production-readback chain.
root_cause: Release truth existed across continuity and one-loop contracts but the specific RECORDED_PENDING_FINAL_DELIVERY_READBACK -> LIVE_PROVEN transition was not yet expressed as one reusable skill contract for every execution node.
prevention: Never translate recorded, committed, merged or deployed into LIVE_PROVEN without same-lineage production/provider readback.
Treat interruption, pending CI, red gates, stale state and missing coupling as recoverable incomplete states.
Resume the same lineage from the last verified checkpoint.
Require outcome evidence and learning/prevention writeback before FULFILLED.
Never reuse historical LIVE_PROVEN evidence to prove a newer exact head.
